name: What happens after the initial remodeling consultation?

mainEntity.name: What happens after the initial remodeling consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: After the initial remodeling consultation, if there's a mutual fit, the contractor will typically prepare a detailed proposal or estimate based on the discussed scope of work. This document will outline the project specifics, estimated costs, and a potential timeline. For larger projects, it might involve further design development or material selections before a final contract is presented. You'll have the opportunity to review this proposal, ask follow-up questions, and request any adjustments before deciding to move forward.
acceptedAnswer.description: After the consultation, the contractor typically provides a detailed proposal or estimate outlining project specifics, costs, and timeline for your review.
